verdict.rationale: MotherDuck is a cloud data warehouse with built-in AI features, so whether customer data is used for model training is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no training opt-out, no data-usage policy, and no statement that customer data is excluded from AI training. Related controls such as SaaS Mode (limits local environment access) and read-only MCP access are different features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
